تستعفوا (form X)
# تَسْتَعْفُوا (tastaʕfū) /tas.taʕ.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْفَى (istaʕfā)
# تُسْتَعْفَوْا (tustaʕfaw) /tus.taʕ.faw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْفَى (istaʕfā)
